result.title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
result.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
result.summary: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对阿尔茨海默病诊断中模态缺失问题，提出「Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers」：模型按模态逐个采样多条填补轨迹，由训练期才有信息的填补教师逐步打分、诊断教师提供软目标，以 on-policy 蒸馏训练出单次 rollout 即可诊断的校准模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐步随机填补加上教师逐步评分与软目标，可能为 LVR 中采样 latent 中间状态、用训练期监督引导并校准缺失视觉证据下的置信度提供方法线索；但属医学多模态诊断，其状态是否真被答案使用尚需核查。
